purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the First Answer vigil at Hearthcoil Hold's Fourth Drain Gate.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for ordinary vigil preparation, four petition choices, the first pulse, the living fourth branch, the hidden command terminator, four interventions, and four state-gated aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the gate establishing view, character and ritual setup, every branch action that changes a visible object or position, the isolated three-branch failure, the calcite counteroffer, the command flare, the witness threshold, and each ending family. The line 'None of them takes the flow' receives its own quiet frame before the fourth branch appears.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt is a complete visible frame for a general image model, including camera, chamber geometry, carved stone and metal materials, light, water, runes, bodies, clothing, tools, and current object placement. Character refs are assembled only for named people visible in that frame. State and branch modifiers add concrete visible deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink drawing under layered gouache and restrained watercolor, monumental carved stone, weathered brass and iron, pale mineral growth, amber work lamps against blue-white mana, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, numinous scale held inside practical civic machinery, cinematic framing for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from global_style_cue plus the scene base_image_prompt, then append visual refs only for visible named characters and any triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Use the camera-specific scene-set blockout when it exists. Keep visual_continuity_notes in tooling, outside prompt prose.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one rectangular gate chamber from west-stair, Hold-facing, throat-facing, table-close, north-plate, and east-ledge angles. Sightlines must preserve the returned sounding weight, the two conduits, the answering array, and every branch-created wound or seal state.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout using the fixed zones, routes, cameras, staging slots, and object-state anchors declared below. Generated frames are paint passes over that geometry, not the room map.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the west stair into a long rectangular underground gate chamber beneath a dwarven city. A waist-high stone rune table stands at center. At the east end, an iron grate with an ankle-high return slot spans a black brine throat under pale calcite folds shaped like thin ribbed gills. A thick municipal bypass pipe runs along the south wall with a wheel valve; near the throat, a newer dark-metal extraction conduit pierces the north wall beneath a polished brass inspection plate. Amber caged work lamps light wet gray stone, salt marks, iron drains, copper leads, and mist; faint blue-white mana sleeps in the calcite edges. The chamber is empty and legible as a civic work site built around a living geological organ.
visual_continuity_notes: West stair, east brine throat, south municipal bypass, north company conduit, central rune table, east ledge, and overhead calcite gills keep these relative positions in every view.
The calcite gills are living mineral folds integrated into the gate ecology, not letters painted onto a wall.

review_notes: Visual self-review checked every base prompt as a standalone frame with explicit room geometry, light, materials, bodies, clothing, tools, and object state; fictional labels are translated into visible forms.

Character refs are attached only to characters listed as visible in each frame. The fourth_drain_core remains environmental presence through water, mineral folds, valves, and returned matter rather than a humanoid body invented for illustration.
Branch and ending modifiers carry reserve loss, salt mapping, witness marks, the safe-refusal wedge, command exposure, gill injury, flow state, and resident posture across folds.
The text scene_set is sufficient for drafting and spatial review. High-consistency multi-angle rendering remains gated on a hand-built plan view or 3D blockout.
